description: Short-Term Photovoltaic Power Forecasting Using an LSTM Neural Network and Synthetic Weather Forecast is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Mohammad Safayet Hossain, Hisham Mahmood (Florida Polytechnic University). The aggregated load of the west region of electrical reliability council of Texas (ERCOT) is usedas the benchmark in this paper. The hourly weatherdata from different local data centers of the same regionis collected from the national renewable energy laboratory(NREL) website for the period of 2012 -2015. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
